collection.title: Audi A3 Hatchback 2003 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2003 to 2004 version of the Audi A3 Hatchback which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this A3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
